prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Using an existing account? Ensure you use the same email to keep your saved pet.", "Need help finding your existing account?"]
1: ["Your pet is coming to life...", "Here is a sneak peek of your desktop companion while final files render."]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Companion", "Watch quick demos of desktop controls, hiding shortcuts, and companion chats.", "Got It! Start Using Pet"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Sign below to seal your bond with your new desktop companion.", "Enter Owner Name", "Certified Companion"]
4: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Try out pet docking and desktop positioning controls before completing setup.", "Test Docking Position", "Launch Companion to Desktop"]
5: ["Sign In or Restore Account", "Choose your provider or verify past account email to preserve pet data.", "Sign In with Google / Provider", "Check Existing Account Email"]
6: ["Desktop Overlay Authorization", "Graphics Render Pipeline Ready"]
7: ["Don't worry—you can adjust or switch your pet path anytime later in settings.", "Flexible Choice"]
8: ["Confirm Pet Appearance", "Review your pet's feature rendering before finalizing adoption.", "Looks Great, Adopt!"]
9: ["Play completion sound when ready"]
